thread.title: Nokia's stock rallies on heavy volume after analyst upgrade - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Nokia's stock rallies on heavy volume after analyst upgrade - MarketWatch
text: The U.S.-listed shares of Nokia Corp. NOK, +12.27% rallied 1.7% in active premarket trade Friday, on the back of an earnings-inspired 12% surge the previous session, after MKM Partners upgraded the Finland-based telecommunications giant, citing an upbeat 5G outlook. Volume was about 1.28 million shares, enough to make the stock the second-most actively traded ahead of the open, behind Apple Inc.'s stock's AAPL, +0.21% 1.31 million shares. MKM analyst Michael Genovese raised his rating to buy, after years of being at neutral, and boosted his stock price target to $7.50 from $5.50. "We have an improving view of the company's technology, product and customer positioning," Genovese said. "We are also encouraged by the latest 5G time lines and capex budgets offered by major early mover carriers." The stock has gained 7.4% over the past three months through Thursday, while the iShares U.S. Telecommunications ETF IYZ, -0.10% has tacked on 1.6% and the S&P 500 SPX, -0.06% has rallied 9.4%.
